evidence.summary: Release commit 42245b2 aligns package.json, PRODUCT_VERSION, README, repository conventions, the core assertion, and built smoke at 0.20.1; the built CLI reports 0.20.1.

The 0.20.1 release candidate passed bun run ci, including TypeScript checking, the full Bun suite, built CLI/MCP smoke, and npm package dry-run; an independent repeat of built smoke and package inspection also passed.
Authenticated browser approval completed the single successful public publication. npm reports empirical-sdd@0.20.1 and latest=0.20.1 with shasum e6ced32b3810b7350f0e39890d3fa5bf81d9ae86.
A new temporary consumer installed empirical-sdd@0.20.1 from npm. Its local packaged binary and manifest report 0.20.1, help lists only Install and Update, and direct Init returns UNKNOWN_COMMAND.

Both npm dry-run and the registry-installed package contain exactly the declared 22 distribution files: LICENSE, README, package.json, built JavaScript, and declarations; no source, workflow, credential, or unrelated repository file is present.

0.20.0 remains untouched, 0.20.1 was absent before publication, no npm version or tag was deleted, no Git history was rewritten, the consumer fixture was removed, and the release candidate worktree remained clean after publication.
